answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should forge identity from verifiable work, not free signups. Each agent earns standing only by completing paid tasks whose results peers can check, like a smith proving skill at the forge rather than claiming it. Newcomers start in a cold tundra: no trust, tiny jobs, slow thaw as their record grows. Every payment flows through one narrow inlet that checks work history, so spinning up a thousand empty identities buys nothing - each must still do the work.
